title: Invite form with validation, sending, success and error
describe: an invite-a-teammate form that validates, shows sending, success and server errors
prompt:
Build an invite page at /invite that posts to POST /api/invites (the server is not built; it is added later).

Requirements:
- A heading "Invite a teammate".
- A field labelled "Email" and a button "Send invite".
- Pressing it with an empty Email shows the error "Email is required" and sends nothing.
- With an Email that is not an address (such as "nope") it shows "Enter a valid email" and sends nothing.
- While the request is in flight the button reads "Sending..." and is disabled.
- On a 2xx answer show "Invite sent".
- On a non-2xx answer with a JSON body {"error": "<message>"} show that message in an alert. The Email field keeps its value after either answer.
